recognize_zh: 周邊血中增加的「淋巴球」其實核偏一側、染色質粗塊狀、旁邊有一圈窄的藍色細胞質（B 箭頭）；高倍 C 還看到雙核與多核的漿細胞，因此是被血球計數器誤判為淋巴球增多的非典型漿細胞白血病。
features: Panel A: increased small mononuclear cells resembling mature lymphocytes, with occasional neutrophils
Small cells with round, slightly eccentric nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin and a narrow rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Panel B (arrows): cells with eccentric nuclei and a crescent of basophilic cytoplasm, suggesting plasmacytoid differentiation
Panel C: binucleated plasma cells and a large multinucleated plasma cell with abundant basophilic cytoplasm
Red cells show mild rouleaux-like stacking in thicker areas
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an increase in small mononuclear cells that at low power resemble mature lymphocytes. At higher magnification, many have eccentrically placed nuclei with clumped chromatin and a narrow crescent of basophilic cytoplasm, and binucleated and multinucleated plasma cells are also present. Findings are consistent with circulating atypical (lymphoplasmacytoid) plasma cells, supporting plasma cell leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD38 bright, CD138+, cytoplasmic light chain restriction) is recommended because automated counters may report these cells as lymphocytes.

ddx.vs: CLL cells have central round nuclei with block-like chromatin, smudge cells and CD5/CD23/CD19 expression, without binucleated plasma cells.
LPL shows a spectrum of CD20+ lymphocytes to plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 mutation rather than a CD138+/CD19− clonal plasma cell population.
Reactive circulating plasma cells are few, polytypic and accompanied by reactive lymphocytes, not numerous atypical multinucleated forms.
